# NebulaSafeTech

> NebulaSafeTech is a cybersecurity and digital solutions company headquartered in Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India. Delivering enterprise VAPT assessments, secure software engineering, full-stack React/Node web application development, UI/UX product design, and EdTech cybersecurity training for organizations and academic partners worldwide.

## Company Information
- **Name**: NebulaSafeTech
- **Location**: Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Email**: info@nebulasafetech.com
- **Phone**: +91 63810 13086
- **Website**: https://www.nebulasafetech.com
- **Key Offerings**: VAPT (Web, Network, Cloud), Full-Stack Web Development, Accessible UI/UX Design Systems, Institutional EdTech Workshops & Academic MoUs.

## Core Documentation & Pages

- [Home](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/): Official landing page, company value proposition, and interactive service showcase.
- [About Us](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/about): Mission, vision, defenders-first philosophy, leadership team, and company history.
- [Services Overview](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/services): Integrated suite of cybersecurity, web engineering, product design, and training services.
- [Cybersecurity Services](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/services/cybersecurity): Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT), cloud security audits, API security, and DevSecOps pipelines.
- [Web Development Services](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/services/web-development): Scalable full-stack web application development using React, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern cloud deployment architectures.
- [UI/UX Design Services](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/services/ui-ux-design): Accessible, user-centered product design, interactive prototyping, and design systems for enterprise SaaS and security software.
- [EdTech & Institutional Training](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/services/edtech-training): Academic cybersecurity workshops, institutional MoUs, curriculum development, and hands-on laboratory setups.
- [EdTech Ecosystem](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/edtech): Student learning paths, practical ethical hacking labs, project guidance, and career preparation.
- [Clients & Testimonials](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/clients): Institutional partnerships, client testimonials, program impact statistics, and case studies.
- [Blog & Technical Insights](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/blogs): Technical articles, security frameworks, web development best practices, and career roadmaps.
  - [AI Agent Security: Identity, Access & Data Protection](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/blog/ai-agent-security-identity-access-enterprise-data): How to secure AI agents with identity, least privilege, authorization, monitoring, and controlled enterprise data access. Covers NIST guidance, the four layers of secure agent access, and practical checklists.
  - [Shadow AI Agents: Enterprise Security Risks in 2026](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/blog/shadow-ai-agents-enterprise-security-risk): How shadow AI agents enter enterprise environments without complete visibility, what access they may hold, and how to discover, govern, and control them.
  - [Ransomware Data Theft: How to Protect Your Business in 2026](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/blog/ransomware-data-theft-protect-business-2026): How modern ransomware combines data theft and extortion, why backups alone are not enough, and how layered data-security controls reduce business risk.
  - [AI Agents & Enterprise Data Security: Risks & Controls](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/blog/ai-agents-enterprise-data-security): Security risks of AI agents accessing enterprise data, with practical controls for safe deployment.
  - [How to Start a Career in Cybersecurity in 2026](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/blog/how-to-start-career-cybersecurity): Beginner roadmap for launching a cybersecurity career.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/privacy-policy): Official data collection, security, and privacy policy documentation.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.nebulasafetech.com/terms-and-conditions): Terms governing site usage, client engagements, and educational programs.
